summary:
Idea Beacon Phase 3 Implementation completed and verified:
- Connected Repositories management (GET /api/repos, POST /api/repos/connect)
- Structured line-by-line File Diff Viewer (DiffViewer.tsx) with hunks, line additions (+), deletions (-), and context lines
- Strict Hold-to-Confirm approval gate (HoldToConfirm.tsx) enforcing 1.5s press-and-hold before committing changes
- 19/19 automated preflight and integration tests passed cleanly (scripts/test-api.ts)
- Clean linter and production compilation.
